description: Know Your Backend: structured, duplication-free backend generation for Claude Code.

plugins.name: kybes
plugins.description: Generates and enforces a predictable backend structure: schema-driven data models in C#, Python, TypeScript and Java, cursor pagination, indexes, transactions, multi-tenancy, ISO 26262-6 unit tests, hot/cold archive and TTL jobs, and guardrail hooks.
